{"stops":[{"poi_id":"p6","kind":"activity","must_do_id":null,"note":"Wander the lanes where artisans keep old crafts alive, and let the colours pull you in."},{"poi_id":"p7","kind":"activity","must_do_id":null,"note":"Cacao from bean to bar, with a whiff of history and a very happy ending."}]}

{"stops":[{"poi_id":"p4","kind":"activity","must_do_id":"m4","note":"The market hums with colour, woven blankets and the scent of fresh fruit—perfect for a gentle first wander."},{"poi_id":"p1","kind":"activity","must_do_id":null,"note":"The old square opens wide under Inti (the sun), its balconies and fountain telling quiet stories of Cusco."},{"poi_id":"p5","kind":"activity","must_do_id":null,"note":"Step inside for golden altars, cedar carvings and a painting of the Last Supper with a very Andean guest on the table."},{"poi_id":"p15","kind":"meal","must_do_id":null,"note":"A plant-filled courtyard and hearty vegetarian plates make this a cosy, easy landing spot for dinner."}]}

{"stops":[{"poi_id":"p3","kind":"activity","must_do_id":"m1","note":"Giant Inca stones with a view over the red-tiled roofs of Cusco."},{"poi_id":"p12","kind":"activity","must_do_id":null,"note":"The white Christ keeps watch over the city, and the whole valley opens up below."},{"poi_id":"p2","kind":"activity","must_do_id":"m2","note":"Sun-washed Inca walls beneath a colonial church, where two worlds share one courtyard."},{"poi_id":"p16","kind":"meal","must_do_id":null,"note":"A refined take on Andean flavours, with plenty of lovely things for the vegetarians."},{"poi_id":"p8","kind":"activity","must_do_id":null,"note":"Textiles, gold and stories of the Inca world, all under one old colonial roof."},{"poi_id":"p18","kind":"meal","must_do_id":null,"note":"Wood-fired warmth and honest vegetarian plates in a cosy old-town corner."}]}
{"stops":[{"poi_id":"p9","kind":"activity","must_do_id":"m3","note":"Wander the terraces and stone paths where the Inti (the sun) still seems to keep watch over the valley."}]}
{"stops":[{"poi_id":"p9","kind":"activity","must_do_id":"m3","note":"Wander the terraces and watch Inti (the sun) light up the old stones."}]}
A soft landing, old Inca stones, the Sacred Valley, and artisan lanes before you fly — your guide in Cusco approves.
